clips.title: The story
paras: At Daphne Stilwell's farm in Westfall, a paladin faces a trial of valor. The Defias Brotherhood is pressing the homestead, and Daphne needs a defender at her side.

Daphne Stilwell's homestead in Westfall lies in land contested by the Defias Brotherhood. While seeking the virtues recorded in the Tome of Valor, you are sent to defend her farm. The Defias have tried repeatedly to overrun the property and kill Daphne. After earlier clashes, another attack is expected. You must stand beside her house instead of retreating to safer ground.

Daphne and you face wave after wave of Defias raiders. She has only her personal firearm, while you have the blessings of the Holy Light. The fight tests whether you can protect someone vulnerable under heavy pressure. True valor is not the pursuit of personal glory, but the willingness to stand between innocent civilians and ruthless violence.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now, they'll be coming again soon, I'd wager, so get yourself ready.
I've got myself a gun in the house. I'll grab it and be ready to help you out, but for the most part, you're on your own.
I've no idea how many they'll send, but I'm sure it'll be more than the few they sent earlier.
Ask the Light for whatever blessings you can because... Did you hear that? I think they're coming.
We make our stand near the house!

clips.title: Progress
paras: We'll make our stand at the house!

clips.title: Completion
paras: We've done it, friend! Thank you for your help. You were truly amazing out there. I never thought an adventurer could handle so many enemies at once.
You've truly shown bravery in the face of overwhelming odds.
